page.overview:
Who is Faux Hero?

The is a young boy dressed in green who can be found in front of . He wishes to get inside the castle and insists that he is 's true hero, but is not allowed in as his appearance does not fit 's , likely because he has round ears.

Although the is never allowed inside the castle, he boasts that he is very popular, and has 15 to prove it. He challenges to a "Chum Challenge" and will give one of his for every hero he has played with over Local Multiplayer or Download Play. If manages to obtain all 15 of his , the will react with disbelief before admitting that he has learned from the experience, referring to henceforth as his "Numero Uno Chum".
